hints.title: Project Grouped Experience Mean
hints.text: Join projects to their assigned personnel to calculate the mean professional experience per project.

hints.title: Aggregation and Rounding Specification
hints.text: Group rows by project identifier and apply average aggregation on employee experience rounded to two decimals.

hints.title: Project Employees Query Blueprint
hints.text: select p.project_id, round(avg(e.experience_years), 2) as average_years from Project p join Employee e on p.employee_id = e.employee_id group by p.project_id.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT p.project_id, ROUND(AVG(e.experience_years), 2) AS average_years
FROM Project p
JOIN Employee e ON p.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY p.project_id;
```

complexity.notes: Equi-join on employee identifier followed by hash grouping executes in linear time relative to table sizes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated scalar subqueries scanning the employee table per assignment yield quadratic complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouped aggregation builds a compact hash table proportional to distinct projects.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of inner join, AVG aggregation, and ROUND to 2 decimal places.

solutions.code:
